note: SEO/indexing fixes: trustHosts/trusted proxies so X-Forwarded-Proto is honoured (canonical/og/sitemap URLs are always the HTTPS apex, never http:// or www); canonical tag now collapses crawl-noise query params (utm/ref/gclid/q) while keeping ?page= and /blog?category=; sitemap duplicate about/contact entries removed; single robots meta tag per page (noindex views set $robots instead of pushing a second tag); robots.txt disallows parameter URL patterns to protect crawl budget.
